payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over possible target segment sums (total_sum / c for c from n down to 1) and greedily scans left-to-right, validating if segments can exactly sum to target, tracking max segment length.
payload.rationale: The greedy left-to-right scan for a fixed target is correct by exchange argument: the first segment must be the shortest prefix summing to target; any valid partition can be adjusted to this cut without increasing max thickness.
